Precor does not make an "arc trainer" Cybex makes the arc trainer. 
Precor makes an AMT 885 (Adaptive Motion Trainer) 
The Precor AMT 885 is a commercial grade machine. It is an elliptical, stepper, treadmill and spin bike all 
in one machine. It has a 19" touch screen console (you can swipe like you do an Iphone) You can get 
intemet and TV (BUT, this must be hard wired, no will) You can incline. It lists for $11,995.00 
Leisure Fitness has a 20% restocking fee. Return/Exchange must be done within 30 days. If we exchange 
the Precor you have now for the AMT they will work with you re the restocking fee. Once a machine is 
delivered it is now considered used and it voids the warranty. 
The machine is huge! it is 29" wide, 48" tall and the max turning radius is 64". Merwin would need to 
make sure this machine can go up in the elevator and make any turns that are required. It is a 3 person job 
for delivery. Weighs 422 lbs. Leisure Fitness has one in stock. 
Just FYI-Leisure Fitness does not carry Cybex. The Cybex "arc trainer" only has one motion where the 
AMT 885 has 4 motions. 
Please advise what you would like to do.

The Androcyte business plan is to patent products based on genomic (and epi-genomic) variants which are unique to one or 
more supercentenarians (SC). Each such DNA variant can be used to design and manufacture variant-specific RNAi 
molecules, proteins, and CRISPR guide-RNAs. The CRISPR is used for changing DNA in human cells (stem cells, neurons, 
etc) to match the SC variant or reversible activation or inhibition of the SC-impacted gene. Since we (Androcyte) have (by 
far) the most SC resources (including genomic variants already undergoing computational analyses) and have co-invented 
the CRISPR technology, we are in unique position to develop these therapies swiftly. These products will be tested in 
animals and in partnerships with pharmaceutical and skin care companies. Pharmaceuticals are becoming more costly due 
to increasingly smaller (personalized) markets (e.g. Glybera at $1.6M per treatment) -- Hence the prospect of Androcyte 
therapies that apply to every person (with access to reasonable health care) is a opportunity for cost reduction and better 
margins due to huge markets. We will submit the first patent by Dec 2014 and begin CRISPR experiments and partnering 
discussions immediately thereafter. 
Examples of potential partners for Androcyte:

Hi George, 
Here's some background on the company, for you and your advisers. When we started in January of 2010, we raised 
$100,000 from three investors for Acron Cell LLC. As you may recall, I dissolved the original company, Acron Cell LLC, 
and sold the assets to a new Florida company called Androcyte LLC, in 2011. Parijata "Jam" Mackey and I took over that 
company's management, although Jam is no longer involved. We had 3 original investors in Acron Cell which were 
allowed to move their ownership percentages to Androcyte. One of those investors, Life Extension Foundation, has put 
$215,000 in total into the Company, and Zasis LLC (owned/managed by Gary Hirst) has put about $340,000 into 
Androcyte, since the beginning. For about one year, Jam and I each had a salary of about $60,000 each, but that ended in 
October of 2012 and there have been no salaries since then, only living expenses (modest housing, food, utilities, and 
travel) The bulk of the funding was used in 2011 - 2012 to pay for travel to Europe to collect blood samples and to 
negotiate a grant and loan from the Spanish government to move the business to their Andalusian biotechnology center at 
Isla de la Cartuja, outside Seville. Setting up the Spanish subsidiary and applying for the grants/loans took about three 
months, and cost us about $30,000. Although we were told we'd get both, the collapse of the Spanish economy fouled this 
from happening. We then sequenced the first three genomes for $20,000 apiece, and in 2012 sequenced another 12 
genomes for $8,000 apiece (both sets were contracted through Knome). I spent the Summer of 2013 in Arlington, MA 
working on analyzing this genomic data on both Knome's and Ingenuity's Variant Analysis platforms. 
Fll pull together our existing shareholder list, if you'd like it. You were given 2% of the company's initial stock and the 
other four advisers were given I percent each. Jam now is a 2% "adviser" rather than an employee/manager. Everyone, 
including these investors and myself  all have dilutable ownership units of Androcyte LLC. All investments have been 
made on a Pre-money Valuation basis and represent whatever valuation we've agreed to with the investor. Previously 
(2012 and 2013) our valuation has been $2,500,000. That's also the amount I quoted the potential investor with whom I've 
been negotiating recently. Because there's much more to be gained by having you as an investor, I promised you a 
valuation of $2,000,000. If we receive your investment, then I'll tell the other guy that we're no longer seeking funds, but 
I'll keep in touch with him regarding future investment opportunities. Hopefully with the new analysis and adding to our 
samples and genomic data, our valuation will increase significantly. As previously offered, I'm happy to have you help 
make such decisions in the future. 
Please let me know if you have any questions. I attaching copies of our 2011 and 2012 tax returns, but the 2013 tax return 
hasn't been completed yet. One of the uses of new funds is to pay about $4,000 to have them done. 
Best regards, 
James

scheduled pick-up time for domestic reservations. International reservations require 24 hour notice of cancellation. This applies to (Sedans, Vans,

passengers unprepared to depart at the scheduled pick-up time will be charged at the hourly rate for the vehicle. Charges will be assessed in fifteen 
minute increments. Domestic Airport and train arrivals (except for private planes) are exempt from this policy. International Arrivals after a one hour 
grace period, are subject to wait time fees of the hourly rate of the vehicle booked. STOPS: Passengers requesting to stop during a "flat rate" trip will

mile or more (total) from the route; and/or, 2) the total time associated with the stop is ten minutes or more. TOLLS: 'Flat rate" trips are charged a 
standard toll for that zone. Hourly trips will be billed for the standard toll charges. PARKING: "Flat rate" trips are charged a standard parking charge

estimate of charges for the proposed trip. The passenger will be responsible for payment of the final charges which may be higher or lower than the

Eclipse Lacrosse Club is pleased to announce our Fall 2014 tryout dates for teams to compete this 
Fall, Winter, and next Summer.

upon our Program accomplishments. 
This Fall we will be holding tryouts in the following grades: 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 
2022, 2023, & 2024 
Registration for our 2016, 2017, 2018 teams is now open 
EFTA00364342

Registratoin for our 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, & 2024 teams will be open in the coming 
days. 
This year we will continue our 5 different program models, and expand upon each offering. 
We will be adding Fall and Winter programming to our calendar which will enable our players to 
develop prior• to the Spring (HS or Youth) and Summer (Club) Seasons. We feel very strongly at 
Eclipse that it is important to be a multi-sport athlete. Not only does this help our players 
develop into better overall athletes through transferable skills and year-round game competition, 
it is also something that college coaches look for in recruits. It is because of this that we have 
organized our fall and winter programming with other sport schedules in mind. Note: We are 
still finalizing a few details regarding our Youth offering, as we wait for final schedules from 
other sports to be published completely. We would like to thank all the people who have helped

guaranteed a spot for the Fall 2014 / Summer 2015. All Players selected to our 2016, 2017, & 2018 teams 
will attend five (5) Fall clinic / practice sessions and two or three (2 or 3) Fall recruiting tournaments. Players 
selected who are unable to attend Fall Clinics or Fall Tournaments will maintain their roster spot on our 
summer teams. We will be selecting alternates for our fall teams (to replace players who cannot compete due 
to injury, other sports, etc). Coaches at our clinics will be a mix of Eclipse Directors, Eclipse Coaches, and 
"Guest" Coaches. Similar to the summer, we have organized one of the best coaching staffs in the country! 
Full details regarding our coaches for our clinics will be announced at our tryouts. 
Tournaments in November: Our 2016, 2017, and 2018 teams will be going to the following 
Sunday November 2nd - Legacy Invitational in Boston (2016, 2017, 2018) 
Sunday November 9th - Harvard Crimson Fall Classic (2016, 2017, 2018) 
Sunday Novemebr 16th - 2016 / 2017 Combined Team NXT Philly Invitational 
Sunday November 23rd - 2018 NXT Philly Invitational (2018) 
Elite Development Program - 2019 & 2020 - We will be selecting players to participate on our Fall 
2014 / Summer 2015 HS Teams in the 2019 & 2020 classes. We will have two teams in each grade level and 
players selected to these teams will be guaranteed a spot for the Fall 2014 / Summer 2015. All Players 
selected to our 2019 & 2020 teams will attend eight to ten (8 to 10) Fall clinic / practice sessions. We will be 
selecting one team in each grade to attend one (1) Fall Tournament. Players selected who are unable to attend
